title: Condensed hero lattice — onboarding asset pack & responsive screens
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Replace the current Quickstart landing hero with a condensed, low-noise ‘lattice’ treatment that scales from mobile to widescreen and reduces visual clutter while preserving step visibility and conversion calls. Deliver a packaged asset set: static hero art (3 breakpoints), animated Lottie loop, step diagram SVGs with accessible markup notes, and a screenshot micro-library for Release 2026.03. Goals: improve perceived speed of onboarding, increase click-through to Quickstart templates, and reduce cognitive load for first-run users. Success metrics: +8% CTA click-through, -12% bounce on quickstart landing, accessible hero (contrast and keyboard focus) verified by audit.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file contains responsive frames for 320/768/1440 with exported assets
Lottie animation renders under 300KB and loops gracefully at 60fps cap
Step diagram SVGs are componentized with semantic labels and fallback PNGs
Screenshot library includes annotated masks and device frames for mobile/desktop
Design tokens and spacing variables documented for handoff to frontend
Accessibility checklist passed (contrast ratios, keyboard focus, motion-safe variant)
